Callout.Name: Garage Fire
Callout.Message: Fire in a domestic garage with fuel inside.

Script.Line: There is a motorbike in there and a can of petrol beside it.
It is attached to the house. That is what I am worried about.
I opened the door and it went up in my face. That is why my eyebrows have gone.

Lines.Approach: There is fuel in there and everybody is out. Keep well back from the doors.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
